sources.name: flint

sources.name: steel_material_polish
sources.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one flat material-panel sheet for the existing original Retold STEEL ARMOR game texture. The first supplied image is the CURRENT UV texture reference, and the second is its current OFFLINE EQUIPMENT RENDER for material/design reference only. Improve the same cool silver steel set, preserving its simple unornamented Minecraft-compatible plate armor identity and a tone darker/cooler than iron.

Output ONE WIDE RECTANGULAR PANEL SHEET, a crisp hard-edged 4-COLUMN by 2-ROW arrangement of eight equal SQUARE panels, edge to edge, NO gutters, labels, lines or margins. Canvas has 64 x 32 logical square pixels, displayed enlarged. Every panel is 16 x 16 logical pixels. This is raw material artwork to crop and mechanically pack into existing armor UVs, NOT a humanoid illustration, NOT an unfolded UV atlas.

Top row left to right:
1. Helmet front material: narrow pale steel brow, darker cheek walls, calm midtone; recognizable broad brow and two cheeks. The actual face opening is preserved later by the original alpha mask. Keep the useful front design in the central 8x8 pixels.
2. Helmet BACK material: closed, calm steel with a quiet dark lower neck guard and two pale corner edges; absolutely NO visor, face opening, eyes or front-face details.
3. Chest FRONT: a clear simple collar at upper edge, broad calm blue-grey breastplate, restrained pale edge at shoulders, darker lower hem. Design occupies central 8 pixels wide by 12 tall.
4. Chest BACK: a simple broad calm back plate, different from the front: no collar opening, no V neck, no breastplate motif; just narrow shoulder edge and restrained dark lower hem. Design occupies central 8x12.

Bottom row left to right:
5. ARM: one narrow vertical bracer panel, central 4x12 logical pixels: lighter shoulder cap at top, quiet middle, subtle dark wrist seam at bottom; no breastplate details.
6. LEGGING: narrow vertical solid greave panel central 4x12: one quiet knee edge, calm shin, darker lower ankle; do not put wrist/collar details here.
7. BOOT: narrow vertical steel boot panel central 4x12: restrained toe cap and darkest sole occupying its lower quarter; upper area calm steel.
8. PLAIN STEEL: quiet 16x16 material swatch for sides and tops, almost flat cool grey-blue with just a few 2-3 pixel broad stepped metal tones, no panel borders or ornaments.

Color palette: ONLY these seven flat colors or extremely close shades: deepest blue grey #394957, shadow #526374, mid shadow #6a7d8d, base steel #8296a6, light steel #9aabba, edge #b5c4ce, brightest edge #d7e0e5. Keep broad calm shapes. Deliberate sparse pixel clusters. The lightest color is a one-pixel edge accent, not a large white patch. No colored cyan/blue diagnostic pixels. All eight panels use the SAME coherent material.

Constraints: original artwork only, opaque sheet. No random speckling, mottling, microtexture, gradients, bloom, PBR, gloss, gold, rivet spam, insignia, rust or fancy fantasy detailing. No text, numbers, letters, grid, labels, perspective, model render, character, skin or transparent holes. Crisp Minecraft-scale pixel art, flat hard uniformly square logical pixels, NO antialiasing. The final artist intent is cleaner planes and distinct FRONT/BACK surfaces, not additional complexity.
processing: Point reduction of generated eight-panel artwork to a 64x32 sheet.
ImageMagick +dither -remap to the seven exact steel palette colors: #394957, #526374, #6a7d8d, #8296a6, #9aabba, #b5c4ce, #d7e0e5.
Crop generated material panels, resample with point filtering and pack individual front/back/side/top faces into the unchanged adult and 26.2 baby equipment UVs.
Keep chest front/back and helmet front/back distinct; separate generated bracer, greave and boot materials.
Apply exact pre-polish alpha channel from archived existing PNGs using CopyOpacity. No Minecraft pixels, new art drawing, geometry, stats or gameplay changes.

sources.name: guardian_material_polish
sources.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference image is the existing flat Retold Earth Guardian atlas, used only for established warm grey stone, sparse muted olive moss, closed blind face and ancient carved-statue character. Rebuild its artwork as ONE MATERIAL PANEL SHEET for this single guardian asset, NOT a finished UV map and NOT a character illustration. Exact 64x32 logical pixel canvas enlarged to a crisp 2:1 sheet. Four equal edge-to-edge vertical columns, each exactly16 logical pixels wide and32 high, no gutters, labels or outlines between them. COLUMN1, x0..15: upper16x16 is a square, flat, front-facing ancient carved stone face: heavy quiet brow, TWO CLOSED DARK HORIZONTAL SLITS with no eyeballs/pupils/glow, short broad squared nose, small recessed mouth, plain blocky cheek planes; the lower16x16 is quiet undecorated stone material. COLUMN2, x16..31: a tall monolithic chest surface, calm central12pixel-wide carved stone plane, slightly darker narrow side planes, a short shallow fracture low near one corner, a hint of moss at lower edge, NO breastplate rim, face, symbols or brickwork. COLUMN3, x32..47: solid tall rectangular stone limb panel, mostly uninterrupted warm grey plane, one restrained stepped fracture near the bottom quarter and sparse dark olive moss near that fracture, subtle top and bottom worn edges; no dense joint bands or outlines. COLUMN4, x48..63: plain reusable seamless stone surface, large calm midgrey areas with only a few connected 2-3pixel darker chips and one small olive moss cluster, NO diagonal camouflage. ALL ART must use the SAME tightly controlled seven flat shades: deepest crevice #3e443b, dark stone #62665b, mid stone #7e8173, light stone #999b89, edge #b1b09b, dark moss #555d3c, moss #70764e. Broad connected pixel clusters and quiet surfaces. No gradients, anti-aliasing, microtexture, random per-pixel noise, realistic stone photograph, perspective, lighting vignette, grid, text, icon, armor, iron-golem nose or copied Minecraft pixels. Entire sheet is opaque, every logical pixel is a hard uniform square. Preserve the old blind jungle-statue identity while making its carved planes readable.
sources.processing: Nearest-neighbor 64x32 panel reduction, no-dither explicit seven-color remap, mechanical per-face crops/resizes into unchanged 128x64 model UVs. Front, back, sides and top use distinct generated material regions. Opaque atlas. No Minecraft pixels copied.

sources.name: aender_grass
sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE original seamless Minecraft terrain texture, flat top surface of Retold Aender purple grass. Exactly16x16 logical pixels enlarged as perfectly crisp uniform squares, square opaque image filling all edges; no border. Restrained inverted-world palette: dusty medium purple #80558e, low #704d7f, occasional #91649d highlights, deepest#63466f. Natural small connected 2-3pixel foliage clusters and short bent 2pixel grass blades distributed irregularly, calm broad midtone coverage, restrained contrast, no single-pixel random salt-and-pepper noise. Seamless on all edges, equal detail at edges and center, no larger motif or tile border. The surface reads as fine purple living grass at vanilla pixel scale, not stone, woven fabric, bricks, moss camouflage or a noisy checkerboard. No perspective, sky, text, grid, gradients, gloss, lighting baked into tile, bloom or copied game pixels. Original development art for a Minecraft mod.

sources.name: aender_leaves
sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE original seamless cutout Minecraft leaf block texture for Retold Aender trees. Exactly16x16 logical pixels enlarged as hard uniform square pixels. Purple leaves only: middle dusty violet #775183, light#956aa0, shadow#60446f, a few dark#4c375a. Natural interlocking small 2-4pixel leaf clusters, some angular diagonal leaf edges, about12percent genuinely transparent one/two pixel gaps scattered irregularly, gaps continue across tile edges; avoid a centered isolated bush. Consistent midtone across edges and center so it tiles all ways. Restrained contrast and coherent leaf shapes, no white/lilac confetti, heavy dark outline, veins everywhere or checkerboard. Flat usable terrain texture, no isometric cube, decorative frame, text, grid lines, blur, antialias, gradients, glow or copied Minecraft art. True transparent gaps, no colored backdrop.
